title: #353 Important Environment
prompt: Environment is important. It is better for children to grow up in the countryside than in a big city. To what extent do you agree with this statement?

promptSegments.text: It is better for children to grow up in the countryside than in a big city.
To what extent do you agree with this statement?

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The countryside is better for children's health because the air is cleaner and there is more space, allowing children to play in green fields and nature, which leads to more exercise and happiness.

angles.en: Education is also better in the countryside because schools have a calm setting away from city noise, allowing students to focus and learn better.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Children in rural areas benefit from a cleaner environment, having better access to open spaces and fresh air, which improves their physical health and understanding of nature.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Country life allows children to develop a strong connection with nature due to its slower pace, leading to patience and a deeper understanding of life cycles.
